title: Refuse a stale task-sync folder-head projection before it can fork the recorded chain
outcome: A projected folder head that still points to an existing predecessor cannot authorize a second canonical successor.
acceptance: Reproduce an existing predecessor selected in the folder-head projection and refuse with a repair remedy before any object, journal, or task mutation.

Use a keyed successor check in ordinary task-sync reads and effects. Verify compatibility, projection repair and rollback on existing stores without scanning the canonical object table on the hot path.
